text:
Ivy Chen: Heads-up: MeridianAI wants a 4-week POC to validate meridian-22b-clinicalx for discharge summarization + coding. They need HIPAA-ready hosting, BYOK KMS, ability to disable logs, and a 300ms p95SLO for 1.5k-token inputs. Also asked for a cost cap for the trial.
Noah Patel: Got it. Do we have model artifact or HF path? Any tokenizer/positional info?
Ivy Chen: HF path in NDA channel: hf://meridian/meridian-22b-clinicalx. They say avg input ~1.2k tokens, outputs ~180; occasional stitched contexts up to 6k.
R&D-bot: Suggest variants: meridian-22b-q4_k_m-kv (quality) and meridian-11b-slim (latency fallback). Run tokenizer diff and rope/rotary check.
Sam Ortega: Ops: For 6k contexts use interleaved KV + prefix caching; consider kv-pruning LRU. For 300ms p95 on 1.2k we may need int8-kv and a dedicated 2x A100-80GB pool. Will queue perf runs (q4_k_m and int8-kv).
Noah Patel: SE runbook: 
```
redwoodctl model inspect --model hf://meridian/meridian-22b-clinicalx
redwoodctl perf run --model meridian-22b-clinicalx --quant int8 --kv interleaved --seq-len 6144 --batch 1
```
Noah Patel: Also check tokenizer: `python -c "from tokenizers import Tokenizer; print(Tokenizer.from_file('tokenizer.json').encode('sample'))"`
ops-bot: Ticket created POC-9780: "Meridian meridian-22b-clinicalx POC - HIPAA, BYOK, perf". Assigned: eng-runtime, sales-eng. Link: <internal/POC-9780>.
Sam Ortega: Routing plan: canary 10% to 22b-int8 cluster, auto-fallback to 11b-slim >350ms. Tag routes for cost so billing matches POC cap.
legal-bot: Action: complete security questionnaire + upload SOC2/DPA. Need commitment on non-training clause and deletion report.
Ivy Chen: I'll send questionnaire and sample prompts. Can SE/Ops post perf results and a 3-option pricing sketch (usage-only, 4-week Dedicated commit, Private install) by EOD Wed?
Noah Patel: Will run perf today and post logs.
Sam Ortega: I'll draft Dedicated sizing and pricing cap options after perf.
Ivy Chen: Thanks all :thumbsup: scheduling kickoff Thu 9am PT with Meridian contacts.
